# SI All Logistics and Trading CC (SI ALL Logistics)

> SI All Logistics and Trading CC is Namibia's #1 logistics company. Based in Windhoek, it provides freight forwarding, customs clearance, sea freight via Walvis Bay, air freight, road freight and cross-border trucking, warehousing and last-mile delivery across Namibia and the SADC region. It also runs a custom sports apparel division (with a free 3D Kit Studio) and a wholesale food and beverage supply division.

Contact: info@sialllogistics.com | +264 81 864 6905 (phone and WhatsApp) | P O Box 4567, Olympia, Windhoek, Namibia

## Logistics services
- [Freight forwarding](https://sialllogistics.com/freight-forwarding-namibia.html): Import, export and in-country freight, planned and tracked by one team so nothing falls between carriers, customs and your warehouse.
- [Customs clearance](https://sialllogistics.com/customs-clearance-namibia.html): Declarations, permits and duty paperwork done right, so your goods are released without avoidable delays.
- [Sea freight](https://sialllogistics.com/sea-freight-walvis-bay.html): Container and break-bulk shipments through Namibia's main port, with booking, tracking and port handling coordinated for you.
- [Air freight](https://sialllogistics.com/air-freight-windhoek.html): Urgent and high-value cargo moved by air, with collection and final delivery arranged at both ends.
- [Road freight](https://sialllogistics.com/road-freight-namibia.html): Cross-border and local trucking on the main regional corridors, planned to firm delivery windows.
- [Warehousing](https://sialllogistics.com/warehousing-windhoek.html): Short-term storage, sorting and consolidation in Windhoek, linked directly to your freight and final delivery.
